_comment: Read by the page over a relative fetch, with no Lua in the path, so this
can be edited and the resource restarted without touching any code.
Every key here has a fallback in the page, so removing one renders that
section empty rather than breaking the screen.
The keybinds below were read out of the resources rather than written from
memory. F2/K/TAB are ox_inventory's defaults from init.lua and are only
correct while server.cfg does not set inventory:keys. If that convar is
ever added, this list has to move with it.

news.title: Welcome to State of Mind
news.description: A serious roleplay server built from the ground up. Custom inventory, HUD, dispatch, policing, banking and garages, all written for this server rather than bolted together. Read the keybinds tab before you spawn in.

keybinds.action: Open a nearby or secondary inventory
